title: A MORE SURE WORD OF PROPHECY

blocks.text: “In this special writing we will print some Scriptures concerning prophecy that will be fulfilling more and more as the age begins to culminate!” – “When God warned Noah of things to come he moved with fear and prepared himself and his family for what was ahead! In this hour the real church of God should do likewise! We are nearing the sunset, this is definitely the last twilight of time!” – II Peter 1:19 . . . We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts. – “Prophetic light will overshadow those who are of the true faith; and He will reveal His nearness and guide them!”
“This is no hour to sleep for the spirit is revealing vital and important things!” – Rev. 3:22 . . . He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

II Tim. 4:3-4 . . . For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears; And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables. – “At the end of the age the churches will actually hire men to preach just the opposite of the Word of God leading them into fables and delusion!” – II Tim. 3:13 . . . But evil men and false seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived. – “We see this Scripture fulfilling in the false systems daily!”

“This Scripture is fulfilling all around us and soon shall increase even more!” – St. Matt. 24:24 . . . For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall show great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect. – “We are living in the days of the modern churches of Babylon!” – Rev. 17:5 . . . And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH. – “Notice in verse 4 it speaks of wealth in her hand! Verse 5 speaks of a written mark in her forehead! And this is just exactly where these false churches are headed; the mark of the beast! (Rev. 13:16) A mark in their right hand or in their foreheads! A code mark of doom!” – “The anti-Christ and the false prophet will rise out of false religion and deceive the unsuspecting and the world! For a snare is already set!”

I Tim. 4:1-2 . . . Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils; Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron. – “The earth is about to witness all type of spellbinders, illusions, working with the cult and occult! Sorcery and witchcraft madness is even worsening! They have caught satanic cults sacrificing babies and the drinking of animal and human blood! Satanism and the worship of Satan is on the rise . . . even the authorities contend that this is true!”

Our age is one of perilous times – disobedience to parents – lovers of pleasure more than lovers of God – having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof!” (II Tim. 3:1-5) – “Huge systems heaping treasures for the last days! (James 5:3-6) – This was to take place just at the Lord’s coming!” (vs. 7) “Jesus said as it was in the days of Noe so shall it be at the time of His return!” (Luke 17:26-27) – Gen. 6:1 . . . “It was during a time of the population explosion! We are witnessing this in our time too! – Verse 11 . . . The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence. – “Never before in the history of the world have we seen so many people being murdered! Some are named serial killers or mass murderers, even the slaughter of children, etc. Also drugs and violence are filling the streets! These are all signs of the last days!”

Luke 21:11 . . . And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven. – “We will see these things progress with great destruction with unique and strange signs appearing in the heavens!”

“In this Scripture we see the pitiful condition of the backslidden false church, protestant, various fundamentalism and even some Pentecostals! – Rev. 3:17 . . . Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing, and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked. – “And as verse 16 aptly shows, God will spue them out of His mouth! These are the coming end time conditions!”

“Now concerning the elect, Jesus has some marvelous things prepared for them. – He will unite the true! Harvest time is here!” – Rev. 10:3 . . . And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices. – “And as verse 4 reveals, it was to be kept secret until our time! And then God would pour out His full power upon His children, bring forth the resurrection and translation of His saints!”

“And the Bright and Morning Star of prophecy (Rev. 22:16) will guide and fulfill all that He has spoken!” – “Verse 17 reveals right now the spirit and the bride are making the last call of the harvest! And we know that it is very soon!” – Read verses 20-21 . . . He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. – “Need we say more then as the Bible says, Watch and pray!”
